prompt: How many years earlier would Punxsutawney Phil have to be canonically alive to have made a Groundhog Day prediction in the same state as the US capitol?
answer: Punxsutawney Phil’s first recorded prediction was in **1887**. The U.S. capital moved to Washington, D.C., in **1800**, so Phil would have had to be canonically alive **87 years earlier** to make a prediction there at that time.
